items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Joe Wilson, was he there at the time. [INTERVIEWER] Was Joe Wilson there. He might have been, I can't recall, but I know Johnny Otis.

ctx.x: Yeah, Johnny Otis' band was there, yeah.
What about Joe Wilson, was he there at the time.
Was Joe Wilson there. He might have been, I can't recall, but I know Johnny Otis.
